subject.title: fix(feishu): accumulate streamed final delta chunks (#91562)

question: Should maintainers accept a proof override for this Feishu streaming-card fix after the helper defect is repaired, or require live Feishu/CardKit evidence before merge?
rationale: The external contributor says they lack a live Feishu tenant plus DeepSeek streaming setup, while ClawSweeper cannot mark helper console output and mocked dispatcher tests as sufficient real behavior proof for a user-visible Feishu channel change.

options.title: Repair Then Require Proof Or Override
options.body: Fix the shared-prefix delta bug and branch conflict, then require either redacted live Feishu/CardKit evidence or an explicit maintainer proof override before merge.

options.title: Maintainer-Run Proof Override
options.body: A maintainer can verify the Feishu path in a sanctioned tenant and apply a proof override if live contributor proof remains unavailable.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Streaming Work
options.body: Pause or close this branch if maintainers want the latest-token case handled only in a broader Feishu streaming-card reliability PR.

recommendation.title: Repair Then Require Proof Or Override
